domains.name: vehicle
domains.description: SSOT for all vehicle master data across the enterprise. Owns VIN-level vehicle identity, model configurations, trim levels, MY (Model Year) lifecycle from SOP (Start of Production) to EOP (End of Production), powertrain variants (ICE, HEV, PHEV, EV), platform architectures, and ADAS feature sets. Serves as the authoritative reference for every downstream domain that needs to identify or describe a vehicle instance.

products.name: vin_registry
products.description: SSOT for every physical vehicle instance identified by its 17-character VIN per ISO 3779. Captures decoded VIN structure (WMI, VDS, VIS), manufacturing plant code, production sequence number, build date, model year (MY), line-off timestamp, homologation market, and current lifecycle status (pre-production, in-production, in-transit, in-service, end-of-life). This is the enterprise anchor record — the single identity key — that every downstream domain (sales, aftersales, logistics, mobility, finance) references to identify a specific vehicle unit.
products.reference: ISO 3779 VIN Standard / NHTSA VIN Decoder

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The official Start of Production (SOP) date when the plant commenced or is scheduled to commence volume production. Critical milestone for capital planning, workforce ramp-up, and supplier readiness. Aligns with APQP phase-gate milestones.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - APQP; SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative subdivision where the plant is located (e.g., 'Michigan', 'Bavaria', 'Ontario'). Used for local regulatory compliance, tax jurisdiction, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; CARB Regulations

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: The rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand, expressed in seconds per unit. Calculated as available production time divided by customer demand rate. Fundamental to JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling and line balancing in MES.
attributes.references: SAE International - Manufacturing Engineering; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the plant location (e.g., 'America/Detroit', 'Europe/Berlin'). Used for MES shift scheduling, production timestamp normalization, and cross-plant reporting in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: union_represented
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant workforce is represented by a labor union. Impacts workforce planning, shift scheduling, overtime policies, and collective bargaining agreement compliance in SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; DOT Labor Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between SAP S/4HANA and the Databricks lakehouse, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees (direct and indirect labor) currently employed at the plant. Used for workforce planning, capacity analysis, and regulatory headcount reporting in SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors HR - Workforce Planning; DOT Labor Reporting

products.name: production_line
products.description: Master record for each production line within a plant, including stamping lines, body shop lines, paint booths, and final assembly lines. Tracks line code, line type, designed throughput (JPH - Jobs Per Hour), current shift configuration, AGV integration flags, PLC/SCADA system references, and operational status. Owned by manufacturing as the SSOT for line-level capacity and configuration.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each production line record within the manufacturing data platform. Serves as the primary key for the production_line entity. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production line is physically located. Links to the plant master record for capacity planning, OEE reporting, and regulatory compliance reporting by facility.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §4.4 – Quality Management System; SAP PP Plant Master

attributes.name: sap_work_center_id
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning) work center identifier corresponding to this production line. Enables direct linkage between the lakehouse production_line master and SAP production orders, capacity planning, and cost center assignments in SAP CO (Controlling).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center Master Data; IATF 16949 §8.5.1

attributes.name: agv_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line is integrated with an AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) system for automated material delivery, WIP (Work in Progress) transport, or carrier movement. True = AGV-integrated; False = manual or conventional conveyor-based material handling. Used for automation investment tracking and MES configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1 – Control of Production; ISO 3691-4 – Industrial Trucks Safety

tag_set.value: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Integration Enabled Flag

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Classification of the overall automation level of the production line: manual (predominantly human-operated), semi_automated (mix of manual and robotic operations), highly_automated (majority robotic with human oversight), or fully_automated (lights-out or near-lights-out operation). Used for workforce planning, CapEx investment analysis, and Industry 4.0 maturity assessments.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1; SAE J3016 – Automation Levels (adapted for manufacturing); VDI 2860

attributes.name: ckd_skd_capable
attributes.description: Indicates the assembly kit type this line is configured to process: CKD (Completely Knocked Down — full kit assembly from parts), SKD (Semi Knocked Down — partial pre-assembly), CBU (Completely Built Up — no kit assembly, line-off only), or multi (capable of multiple kit types). Relevant for export assembly plants and regulatory homologation.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29 – Vehicle Regulations; IATF 16949 §8.5.1; Customs Tariff Classification

attributes.name: conveyor_type
attributes.description: Type of conveyor or carrier system used to move vehicles or assemblies along this production line: overhead_conveyor (hanging carrier), floor_conveyor (ground-level chain/belt), skillet (moving platform for final assembly), agv_carrier (autonomous guided vehicle carrier), stationary (fixed-position assembly), or mixed (combination of types).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1 – Control of Production; ISO 3691-4 – Industrial Trucks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production line master record was first created in the data platform (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance, lineage tracking, and IATF 16949 record retention compliance. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §7.5.3 – Control of Documented Information; ISO 9001 §7.5.3

attributes.name: current_jph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Actual Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Rate
attributes.description: The current actual or most recently measured throughput rate of the production line in Jobs Per Hour (JPH), reflecting real-world performance after accounting for constraints, model mix, and current configuration. Used to compare against designed_jph for capacity gap analysis and production scheduling.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §9.1.1 – Monitoring and Measurement; Apriso MES Production Rate

tag_set.value: Current Actual Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Rate

attributes.name: designed_jph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Designed Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Throughput Rate
attributes.description: The engineered design throughput capacity of the production line expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) — the number of vehicle units or assemblies the line is designed to produce per hour under optimal conditions. This is the nameplate capacity used for capacity planning, takt time calculation, and OEE baseline. Maps to MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: SAE J1739 – FMEA; IATF 16949 §8.5.1.1 – Control Plan; SAP PP Capacity Definition

tag_set.value: Designed Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Throughput Rate

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh_per_unit
attributes.description: Average energy consumption of this production line in kilowatt-hours (kWh) per vehicle unit produced. Used for ISO 14001 environmental management reporting, carbon footprint calculation, energy efficiency benchmarking, and EPA/CARB manufacturing emissions compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 §9.1 – Environmental Performance Evaluation; ISO 50001 – Energy Management; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual End of Production (EOP) date for this production line — the date on which series production of the current vehicle program is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity reallocation planning, tooling disposition, and supply chain wind-down management. Nullable for lines with no defined EOP.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.6 – Design and Development Changes; SAP PP Production Program

attributes.name: floor_space_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor space occupied by this production line in square meters, including the line footprint, buffer zones, and material staging areas. Used for facility capacity planning, real estate cost allocation, and plant layout optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 §8.1 – Operational Planning; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.22 – Walking-Working Surfaces

attributes.name: iatf_audit_status
attributes.description: Current IATF 16949 (International Automotive Task Force) quality management system audit status for this production line: compliant (no non-conformances), minor_nc (minor non-conformance identified), major_nc (major non-conformance — corrective action required), suspended (production suspended pending corrective action), or not_audited (not yet subject to IATF audit).
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 – Quality Management System Requirements for Automotive Production

attributes.name: jis_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line operates under JIS (Just-in-Sequence) material delivery sequencing, where parts are delivered to the line in the exact sequence of vehicle build order. True = JIS-enabled; False = standard JIT or batch delivery. Critical for supply chain integration and sequencing system configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.4.3 – Supplier Communication; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: last_iatf_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent IATF 16949 quality management system audit conducted on this production line. Used for audit cycle management, corrective action tracking, and regulatory compliance reporting to OEM customers and certification bodies.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent planned preventive maintenance activity performed on this production line. Used for maintenance scheduling in SAP PM (Plant Maintenance), OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation, and IATF 16949 preventive maintenance compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.5 – Total Productive Maintenance; SAP PM Maintenance Order

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the production line within the plant and across the enterprise (e.g., FA-01, BS-03, PT-02). Used as the business key in MES, SAP PP, and Apriso/Dassault shop-floor execution systems. Maps to BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.2 – Identification and Traceability; Apriso/Dassault MES Line Master

attributes.name: line_length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the production line in meters, measured from the first to the last station. Used for facility layout planning, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) path configuration, and ergonomic compliance assessments per plant engineering standards.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 §8.1 – Operational Planning; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – General Industry Standards

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the production line (e.g., 'Final Assembly Line 1 – Truck Platform', 'Body Shop Framing Line – SUV'). Used in reporting dashboards, capacity planning, and operator interfaces. Maps to IDENTITY_LABEL category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5 – Production and Service Provision; SAP PP Work Center Description

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the production line: active (running production), idle (scheduled downtime or no orders), maintenance (planned or unplanned maintenance), ramp_up (pre-SOP commissioning), ramp_down (approaching EOP), or decommissioned (permanently retired). Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1; SAP PM Equipment Status; Apriso MES Line Status

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the production line by manufacturing process area: stamping (metal forming), body_shop (welding/framing), paint (surface treatment), final_assembly (vehicle build), powertrain (engine/transmission), chassis (underbody), or trim (interior/exterior finishing). Maps to CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for MASTER_RESOURCE role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim|subassembly|battery_pack|quality_gate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1 – Control of Production; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: max_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross vehicle weight in kilograms that this production line's conveyor, tooling, and fixtures are rated to handle. Constrains which vehicle programs can be assigned to this line and is critical for structural safety compliance and tooling certification.
attributes.references: ISO 3691-4 – Industrial Trucks; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.179 – Overhead Cranes; IATF 16949 §8.5.1

attributes.name: mes_line_code
attributes.description: The line identifier as registered in the Apriso/Dassault MES (Manufacturing Execution System) for shop floor execution, work order dispatch, and build traceability. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational MES source system.
attributes.references: ISA-95 – Enterprise-Control System Integration; Apriso/Dassault MES Line Master

attributes.name: mixed_model_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line is capable of producing multiple vehicle models or variants in a mixed sequence on the same line (mixed-model assembly). True = mixed-model capable; False = dedicated single-model line. Drives production scheduling complexity and sequencing logic in MES.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.1 – Control Plan; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: model_year_capability
attributes.description: The model year (MY) or range of model years that this production line is currently tooled and certified to produce (e.g., '2024' or '2024-2026'). Drives SOP (Start of Production) and EOP (End of Production) planning, tooling investment decisions, and homologation scheduling.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.2 – Design and Development Planning; NHTSA FMVSS Compliance

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance activity scheduled for this production line. Drives maintenance work order creation in SAP PM, production scheduling adjustments, and downtime planning to minimize impact on JPH targets.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.5 – Total Productive Maintenance; SAP PM Maintenance Planning

attributes.name: number_of_stations
attributes.description: Total count of individual work stations or assembly stations on this production line. Used for line balancing analysis, ergonomic assessments, and determining the number of operators required per shift. Key input for APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and control plan development.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.4.4 – APQP; SAP PP Work Center Station Count

attributes.name: paint_booth_type
attributes.description: Type of paint application system used on this line (applicable to paint shop lines): waterborne (water-based paint — lower VOC emissions), solventborne (solvent-based paint), powder_coat (electrostatic powder coating), or none (non-paint line). Drives EPA/CARB VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) emissions compliance reporting and environmental permit management.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 63 Subpart IIII – Paint Stripping and Miscellaneous Surface Coating; CARB Title 17; ISO 14001

attributes.name: plc_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) system or network controlling this production line's automated equipment (e.g., 'Siemens S7-1500 Network A', 'Allen-Bradley ControlLogix Zone 3'). Used for maintenance management in SAP PM, SCADA integration, and cybersecurity asset inventory.
attributes.references: IEC 61131-3 – PLC Programming Standards; IATF 16949 §8.5.1; NIST SP 800-82 – ICS Security

attributes.name: powertrain_type_capability
attributes.description: The powertrain technology types this production line is capable of assembling: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle), or multi (flexible line supporting multiple powertrain types). Critical for EV transition capacity planning and regulatory compliance with EPA/CARB emissions standards.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: quality_gate_count
attributes.description: Number of quality inspection gates or checkpoints integrated into this production line (e.g., in-process inspection stations, end-of-line audit points). Used for quality planning per APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), control plan documentation, and IATF 16949 compliance audits.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.6 – Release of Products; APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation

attributes.name: robot_count
attributes.description: Total number of industrial robots (welding, painting, assembly, material handling) deployed on this production line. Used for maintenance planning in SAP PM, automation investment tracking, and Industry 4.0 KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 10218 – Robots and Robotic Devices Safety; IATF 16949 §8.5.1

attributes.name: safety_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the production line's current safety certification. Used to trigger renewal workflows, prevent operation of uncertified lines, and support regulatory audit readiness for OSHA, DOT, and IATF 16949 compliance.

attributes.name: safety_certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the production line's safety certification and compliance with applicable occupational safety standards (e.g., OSHA, CE Machinery Directive, ISO 13849): certified (valid and current), expired (certification lapsed), pending_renewal (renewal in progress), or not_required (exempt from certification requirement).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – General Industry; ISO 13849 – Safety of Machinery; EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC

attributes.name: scada_system_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System Reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system monitoring and controlling this production line (e.g., 'Ignition SCADA Plant2-Zone1', 'Wonderware InTouch Line FA-01'). Used for real-time production monitoring, alarm management, and integration with MES and ERP systems.
attributes.references: IEC 62443 – Industrial Cybersecurity; IATF 16949 §8.5.1; NIST SP 800-82

attributes.name: shift_configuration
attributes.description: Current shift schedule configuration for the production line, indicating the number of operating shifts per day: 1_shift (single day shift), 2_shift (day and afternoon), 3_shift (continuous 24-hour), or 4_shift_rotating (rotating continental schedule). Drives capacity planning, workforce scheduling in SuccessFactors, and MRP calculations in SAP PP.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1; SAP PP Shift Definition; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The official Start of Production (SOP) date for this production line — the date on which the line commenced or is scheduled to commence series production of the current vehicle program. Used for program milestone tracking, APQP phase gate management, and regulatory homologation scheduling.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.2 – Design and Development Planning; APQP Phase 5 – Launch

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: The calculated takt time for this production line in seconds — the maximum allowable time to produce one unit to meet customer demand. Derived from available production time divided by customer demand rate. Stored as a master configuration value for scheduling and line balancing in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) operations.
attributes.references: SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing; IATF 16949 §8.5.1.1 – Control Plan

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this production line master record in the data platform (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §7.5.3 – Control of Documented Information; ISO 9001 §7.5.3

attributes.name: vehicle_platform_code
attributes.description: The vehicle platform or architecture code that this production line is primarily configured to build (e.g., 'F-150 Gen14', 'GMT800', 'MEB'). A single line may support multiple model variants on the same platform. Used for PLM integration with Siemens Teamcenter and production scheduling.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Platform Configuration; IATF 16949 §8.3 – Design and Development

attributes.name: weld_gun_count
attributes.description: Total number of resistance spot weld guns (robotic and manual) deployed on this production line. Applicable primarily to body shop lines. Used for weld quality management per IATF 16949, preventive maintenance scheduling in SAP PM, and SPC (Statistical Process Control) monitoring of weld quality.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.2 – Control of Special Processes; AWS D8.1M – Automotive Spot Welding

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master record for individual work centers (stations) within a production line. Captures work center code, name, type (manual, automated, robotic), cycle time standard, takt time, capacity category, shift availability, and associated PLC/SCADA node identifiers. Supports JIS sequencing and MES shop floor execution at the station level.

Informs CapEx planning and Industry 4.0 transformation roadmap.

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Total available production hours per day for this work center, accounting for planned shift schedules and scheduled breaks. Used in SAP PP capacity requirements planning (CRP) and MES scheduling.

attributes.name: capacity_category

attributes.name: category

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the work center across MES, SAP PP, and SCADA systems. Used as the business key in cross-system integration (e.g., Apriso/Dassault MES work center identifier).

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this work center was officially commissioned and made available for production use. Used for asset age tracking, depreciation calculation, and maintenance lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM/AA Module; IATF 16949; ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center master record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Standard cycle time in seconds for this work center to complete one unit of work. Used in production scheduling, capacity calculation, and bottleneck analysis. Represents the designed throughput rate per station.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Standard Value Key); IATF 16949; SAE International

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this work center was or is planned to be permanently decommissioned and removed from production service. Nullable for active stations. Used for asset lifecycle planning and capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the work center's function, scope of operations, and any special capabilities or constraints relevant to production planning and scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kw
attributes.description: Rated energy consumption of this work center in kilowatts (kW) under standard operating conditions. Used for energy management, sustainability reporting, and ISO 14001 environmental compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ISO 50001 Energy Management; EPA Emissions Standards

attributes.name: floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Physical floor area occupied by this work center in square meters. Used for facility layout planning, ergonomic assessments, and plant capacity management.

attributes.name: is_bottleneck
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center has been identified as a production bottleneck constraining overall line throughput. Bottleneck stations receive priority in capacity planning, maintenance scheduling, and continuous improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: is_jis_enabled

attributes.name: is_quality_gate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center serves as a quality gate (inspection checkpoint) in the production flow. Quality gate stations require SPC (Statistical Process Control) data capture and may hold WIP pending quality approval.

attributes.name: labor_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Standard direct labor cost rate per hour (in local currency) for this work center. Used in production order costing, standard cost roll-up, and labor efficiency variance reporting.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this work center master record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: location_description

attributes.name: machine_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Standard machine cost rate per hour (in local currency) for this work center, used in production order costing, standard cost calculation, and variance analysis in SAP CO.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_code

attributes.description: Manufacturing overhead absorption rate as a percentage applied to this work center's direct costs for product costing and standard cost calculation in SAP CO.

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Manufacturing process category to which this work center belongs, reflecting the major shop segment (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly, powertrain). Used for shop floor segmentation, capacity analysis, and APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim|quality_inspection|logistics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949; APQP Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: production_line_code

attributes.name: sap_work_center_code

attributes.name: scada_node_code

attributes.description: Identifier of the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) node associated with this work center. Enables real-time monitoring, alarm management, and production data acquisition from the shop floor.
attributes.references: IEC 62443 (Industrial Cybersecurity); SCADA Integration; Apriso/Dassault MES

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Node ID

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard setup/changeover time in minutes required to prepare this work center for a new production run or model variant. Used in SAP PP capacity planning and MES work order scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Standard Value Key); IATF 16949

attributes.name: shift_model_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the shift schedule model assigned to this work center (e.g., 1-shift, 2-shift, 3-shift, weekend shift). Determines available production windows for capacity planning and MES scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Shift Definition); IATF 16949

attributes.name: standard_value_key
attributes.description: SAP PP standard value key (e.g., SAP1, SAP2) defining which standard values (setup, machine, labor, teardown times) are relevant for this work center in routing operations. Governs how production order times are calculated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Standard Value Key SAP1-SAP6); IATF 16949

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Takt time in seconds representing the rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand. Calculated as available production time divided by customer demand rate. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) line balancing and MES pacing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949; SAE International J4000

attributes.name: teardown_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard teardown/cleanup time in minutes required after completing a production run at this work center. Included in total station time calculations for capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Standard Value Key); IATF 16949

attributes.name: work_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work center: active (in production use), inactive (temporarily not in use), under_maintenance (scheduled or unscheduled maintenance), decommissioned (permanently retired), or planned (not yet commissioned). Drives MES scheduling eligibility and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: work_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work center by its operational mode: manual (human-operated), automated (machine-driven without robotics), robotic (robot arm/AGV-integrated), semi_automated (human-assisted automation), inspection (quality gate), or rework (defect correction station). Drives capacity planning and labor allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; SAE International

products.name: production_order
products.description: Core transactional record representing a manufacturing work order issued to produce a specific vehicle or sub-assembly. Captures order number, order type (vehicle build, sub-assembly, rework), planned and actual start/finish dates, target quantity, produced quantity, order status, priority, shift assignment, and MES order reference. Links to plant, production line, and vehicle configuration. SSOT for shop floor execution tracking in SAP PP and Apriso MES.
products.reference: SAP PP Production Order / Apriso MES Work Order

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for production_order

attributes.name: configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle configuration or variant being built under this production order. Links to the vehicle configuration master (model, trim, powertrain, options) managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SAP Variant Configuration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP Variant Configuration; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: customer_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Order‑to‑customer linkage required for order fulfillment, warranty, and recall reports; manufacturers need to know which party placed each production order.

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Production Order release process checks Homologation_Record to ensure model/year has regulatory approval before manufacturing starts.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_line. Business justification: In SAP PP-SD integration, a production order is created to fulfill a specific sales order line (schedule line). This link enables order confirmation, delivery date commitment, and production cost allo

attributes.name: organization_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.organization_account. Business justification: Required for fleet sales processing: link production order to the purchasing fleet account for order tracking, invoicing, and delivery coordination.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production order is executed. Corresponds to the SAP Plant (WERKS) organizational unit. Links to the plant master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_purchase_order. This PP→MM in

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Enables Production Order Supplier Impact Analysis, identifying the primary supplier for critical components.

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) version used for this production order. The BOM defines all components and sub-assemblies required to build the target material. Managed in SAP PP and Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly) assigned to execute this order. Maps to SAP Work Center (ARBPL) or MES line definition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_schedule. Business justification: Production orders are issued to fulfill a master production schedule (MPS). Many production orders are created under one production_schedule. This FK establishes the standard parent-child relationship

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing (task list / operation sequence) assigned to this order. The routing defines the sequence of manufacturing operations, work centers, and standard times. Maps to SAP PP Routing (PLNNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP Material Master (MATNR) representing the finished vehicle, sub-assembly, or component being produced. The primary product/material being manufactured under this order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The total actual cost incurred to execute this production order, including material consumption, labor, machine, and overhead costs as settled in SAP CO. Expressed in the plant's local currency. Used for cost variance analysis, profitability reporting, and CapEx/OpEx tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when all production activities for this order were completed and the final goods receipt was posted, as recorded by MES or SAP PP. Used for cycle time calculation, OTD (On-Time Delivery) measurement, and throughput analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total actual direct labor hours consumed during execution of this production order, as confirmed through SAP PP operation confirmations or MES time tracking. Used for labor efficiency analysis, variance reporting, and cost actuals in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total actual machine/equipment hours consumed during execution of this production order, as recorded by SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems or MES. Used for OEE analysis, machine utilization reporting, and cost variance calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; SCADA; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when production activities for this order actually commenced on the shop floor, as recorded by the MES or confirmed by the first operation confirmation in SAP PP. Used for cycle time analysis and schedule adherence measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: assembly_sequence_number
attributes.description: The Just-in-Sequence (JIS) sequence number assigned to this production order, defining its position in the assembly line build sequence. Critical for JIS supply chain synchronization — ensures parts arrive at the line in the exact order vehicles are built. Managed by MES and communicated to tier-1 suppliers.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of vehicles or sub-assemblies that have been confirmed as successfully produced and goods-receipted against this order. Maps to SAP PP confirmed yield quantity (WEMNG). Used for production performance and yield tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production order record was first created in the source system (SAP PP). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management. Maps to SAP order creation timestamp (ERDAT + ERZET).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard_cost and actual_cost amounts on this production order (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, MXN). Determined by the plant's controlling area currency in SAP CO.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production order involves the use or production of hazardous materials (e.g., battery electrolytes for EV/HEV powertrains, paint solvents, chemical treatments). True = hazardous materials involved, requiring compliance with EPA, CARB, and ISO 14001 environmental management protocols.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production order record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change tracking, delta load processing in the lakehouse pipeline, and audit compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: mes_order_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system for this production order. Used to correlate SAP PP orders with shop floor execution records in the MES for traceability and real-time production control.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the units being produced under this order. Critical for regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA, NCAP), warranty tracking, and production program management. Typically a 4-digit year (e.g., 2025).
attributes.references: NHTSA; EPA; CAFE Standards; SAE International

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the production order was created and issued in SAP PP. This is the principal business event date representing when the manufacturing work order was formally raised. Maps to SAP order creation date (ERDAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the production order providing additional context about the manufacturing scope, special instructions, or engineering change notes. Used by shop floor supervisors and production planners for operational clarity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the production order as assigned by SAP PP (Production Planning) or Apriso MES. This is the business-facing reference used on the shop floor, in MES screens, and in cross-system communication. Maps to SAP PP order number (AUFNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production order within the SAP PP and MES workflow. 'created' = order created but not yet released to shop floor; 'released' = released for execution; 'in_progress' = active manufacturing underway; 'partially_confirmed' = some operations confirmed; 'confirmed' = all operations confirmed; 'technically_completed' = TECO status in SAP — production complete, pending settlement; 'closed' = fully settled and archived; 'cancelled' = order voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|partially_confirmed|confirmed|technically_completed|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production order indicating its manufacturing purpose. 'vehicle_build' represents a full vehicle assembly order; 'sub_assembly' covers component or module builds (e.g., powertrain, axle); 'rework' covers defect correction orders; 'repair' covers warranty or field return repairs; 'prototype' covers R&D and pre-SOP (Start of Production) builds. Maps to SAP PP order type (AUART).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which all production activities for this order are planned to be completed. Used for delivery commitment, JIT (Just-in-Time) scheduling, and OTD (On-Time Delivery) performance tracking. Maps to SAP PP planned finish date (GLTRS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: planned_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total planned direct labor hours required to execute this production order, derived from the routing standard times and target quantity. Used for capacity planning, workforce scheduling via SuccessFactors, and standard cost calculation in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; SuccessFactors; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: planned_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total planned machine/equipment hours required to execute this production order, derived from routing standard machine times. Used for equipment capacity planning, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) baseline, and standard cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which production activities for this order are planned to begin, as determined by MRP (Material Requirements Planning) or production scheduling. Maps to SAP PP planned start date (GSTRS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MRP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: ppap_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) approval is required before this production order can be released for full-volume production. Typically True for new part introductions, engineering changes, or supplier changes. Governed by IATF 16949 and AIAG PPAP standards.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority level assigned to this production order for shop floor scheduling and sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by MES and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) systems to determine execution order when multiple orders compete for the same resources.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS

attributes.name: production_stage
attributes.description: The manufacturing stage or shop area where this production order is executed. Reflects the physical production process: 'stamping' = metal forming; 'body_shop' = body-in-white welding; 'paint' = surface coating; 'final_assembly' = vehicle assembly; 'powertrain' = engine/transmission build; 'trim_chassis' = trim, chassis, and final fit.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5; SAE International

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot
attributes.description: The SAP QM (Quality Management) inspection lot number created for quality inspection activities associated with this production order. Links production execution to quality results, usage decisions, and non-conformance records. Maps to SAP QM inspection lot (QMNUM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production order was formally released to the shop floor for execution. Release triggers material staging, capacity reservation, and MES order activation. Maps to SAP PP order release date/time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units that required rework (non-conforming units corrected and returned to production flow) during execution of this order. Distinct from scrap — reworked units are salvaged. Used for quality cost analysis and APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; APQP

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units scrapped or rejected during production of this order due to quality defects or process failures. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation, scrap cost analysis, and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC

attributes.name: sop_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production order is part of the SOP (Start of Production) launch phase for a new vehicle program. True = SOP launch order subject to enhanced quality monitoring and APQP controls; False = regular series production order.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The planned standard cost to produce the target quantity under this order, calculated from the BOM (Bill of Materials) component costs and routing activity rates in SAP CO (Controlling). Expressed in the plant's local currency. Used for cost variance analysis and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of vehicles or sub-assemblies to be produced under this order, expressed in the base unit of measure (typically 'EA' for each). Maps to SAP PP planned order quantity (GAMNG). Used for capacity planning and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: technical_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production order was set to Technically Completed (TECO) status in SAP PP, indicating all manufacturing operations are finished and the order is pending cost settlement. Distinct from actual_finish_timestamp which records the last physical operation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the target and confirmed quantities on this production order (e.g., EA = Each for vehicles, PC = Piece for components, SET for kits, KG for bulk materials). Maps to SAP base unit of measure (MEINS).

attributes.name: vin_range_end
attributes.description: The last VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) in the sequential range assigned to units produced under this order. Together with vin_range_start, defines the complete set of vehicles traceable to this production order for recall, warranty, and homologation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J272

attributes.name: vin_range_start
attributes.description: The first VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) in the sequential range assigned to units produced under this order. VINs are 17-character alphanumeric identifiers conforming to ISO 3779. Used for build traceability, recall management, and regulatory reporting to NHTSA.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J272

attributes.name: wip_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether WIP (Work in Progress) costs have been calculated and posted to the financial ledger for this production order in the current period. True = WIP posted; False = WIP not yet posted. Used for period-end financial closing in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP/IFRS IAS 2

attributes.description: Reference to the specific assembly or production line to which this build sequence is assigned. Drives AGV routing and JIS supplier call-off logic.

The build_sequence defines the ordered vehicle sequence within a scheduled production window. This FK links each se

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: In automotive MES/SAP AOM integration, a build sequence entry is created in direct response to a confirmed vehicle order — the sequence IS the manufacturing commitment to that order. Production planne

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Build sequencing records must be traceable to the VIN registry for production audit trails, homologation market assignment, and recall scope determination. The plain vin column on build_sequence is a

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position was completed on the production line, as recorded by the MES. Null until assembly is complete.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position commenced on the production line, as recorded by the MES. Null until assembly begins.

attributes.name: assembly_stage
attributes.description: Current or target assembly stage for this sequence position: 'stamping' = metal forming; 'body_shop' = body-in-white welding; 'paint' = paint application; 'final_assembly' = trim and chassis assembly; 'PDI' = Pre-Delivery Inspection. Drives shop floor routing in the MES.

attributes.name: body_style_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the body style of the vehicle (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck, coupe, van). Influences stamping and body shop routing within the production sequence.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle build purpose: 'retail' = customer-ordered retail unit; 'fleet' = fleet customer order; 'stock' = dealer stock build; 'pilot' = pre-production pilot build; 'homologation' = regulatory homologation unit; 'press' = media/press fleet unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Apriso/Dassault MES; NHTSA; UNECE

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this build sequence record was first created in the MES sequencing module and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: destination_market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the intended destination market for the vehicle. Determines homologation variant, regulatory compliance requirements (NHTSA, UNECE, CARB), and market-specific option content.

attributes.name: drive_configuration
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration of the vehicle: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Determines axle and driveshaft JIS call-off and assembly routing.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; SAE International

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: Paint color code for the vehicle exterior as specified in the build sequence. Drives paint shop scheduling, batch sequencing for color changeover optimization, and JIS paint material call-off.

attributes.name: freeze_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the build sequence was frozen and locked for JIS supplier call-off. After this timestamp, sequence changes are restricted and require formal change control. Critical for JIS supplier synchronization.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: Interior trim and upholstery color code for the vehicle. Used for JIS seat and interior component call-off to tier-1 suppliers.

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Indicates whether the build sequence record has been frozen for JIS supplier call-off. When True, sequence changes are restricted and require formal change control approval. Directly linked to freeze_timestamp.

attributes.name: is_priority_build
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle has been flagged as a priority build (e.g., executive order, critical dealer allocation, regulatory compliance unit). Priority builds may override standard JIS sequencing rules.

attributes.name: jis_call_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the JIS supplier call-off message was transmitted for this sequence position. Triggers sequenced part delivery from tier-1 JIS suppliers. Critical for supply chain synchronization and OTD measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA MM; IATF 16949

attributes.name: mes_sequence_reference
attributes.description: Native sequence record identifier from the Apriso/Dassault MES sequencing module. Serves as the source system key for lineage and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational MES.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Four-digit model year (MY) of the vehicle to be assembled at this sequence position. Determines applicable BOM revision, regulatory homologation requirements, and CAFE/EPA compliance targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; NHTSA; EPA; CAFE

attributes.name: option_package_code
attributes.description: Code representing the bundled option package (e.g., technology package, towing package, safety package) selected for the vehicle. Determines additional BOM components and JIS call-off requirements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: planned_build_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the vehicle at this sequence position is planned to be assembled. Used for JIS supplier call-off scheduling and production planning in SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position is planned to complete. Used for takt time validation and shift throughput planning.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position is planned to begin on the production line. Drives JIS call-off timing and AGV dispatch scheduling.

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain to be assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives line routing, tooling selection, and regulatory compliance checks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; EPA; CARB; CAFE; WLTP

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this build sequence position has been placed on a quality hold, preventing progression to the next assembly stage. Triggered by MES quality gate failures or FMEA-driven stop conditions.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA QM; IATF 16949; APQP

attributes.name: regulatory_variant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory homologation variant of the vehicle (e.g., US-NHTSA, EU-UNECE, CARB-ZEV). Ensures correct BOM variant selection for emissions, safety, and market-specific compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA; UNECE; CARB; EPA; DOT FMVSS; Euro NCAP

attributes.name: sequence_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the most recent modification to this build sequence record (e.g., material shortage, quality hold, customer order change, line disruption). Required for change control audit trail under IATF 16949.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordered position number of this vehicle within the production run for the assigned line and shift. Drives JIS supplier call-off sequencing and AGV routing. Must be unique within a plant, line, shift, and planned build date combination.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949

attributes.name: sequence_revision_number
attributes.description: Incremental revision counter tracking how many times this build sequence record has been modified since initial creation. Supports audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.

attributes.name: sequence_set_number
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier for the production sequence set or run to which this record belongs, as generated by the MES sequencing module. Used for JIS call-off batch identification and supplier communication.

attributes.name: sequence_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the build sequence record within the MES workflow. 'planned' = sequence created but not yet released to shop floor; 'released' = released for production; 'in_progress' = vehicle currently being assembled; 'completed' = assembly finished; 'cancelled' = sequence removed from run; 'on_hold' = temporarily suspended pending resolution.

attributes.name: sequence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the build sequence record indicating whether it is the original planned sequence, a revised sequence after change control, an emergency insertion, or a resequenced position due to line disruption.

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds allocated for assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position. Derived from the line rate and used for production pacing, WIP tracking, and OTD performance measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission to be installed in the vehicle at this sequence position. Drives drivetrain component JIS call-off and assembly station routing.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; SAE International

attributes.name: trim_level_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the trim or grade level of the vehicle (e.g., base, mid, premium, sport). Determines option content, BOM variant, and JIS part call-off requirements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Dassault ENOVIA; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to this build sequence record, as recorded in the MES or Silver Layer. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the vehicle model (e.g., platform or nameplate code) to be assembled at this sequence position. Sourced from Teamcenter PLM product structure.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949

products.name: vehicle_build
products.description: Transactional record capturing the actual build event for a single vehicle unit on the shop floor, from body-in-white through final assembly. Tracks VIN assignment, production order reference, actual start and completion timestamps per build stage (stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final), build status, shift, operator team, and any hold or rework flags. SSOT for vehicle-level build traceability and genealogy in the manufacturing domain.
products.reference: Apriso MES Vehicle Traceability / VIN Build Record

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vehicle_build

attributes.name: build_sequence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.build_sequence. Business justification: A vehicle_build event is executed against a specific JIS build_sequence slot. This FK normalizes the relationship between the actual build event and its planned sequence entry. build_sequence_number (

attributes.name: build_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.build_spec. Business justification: End-of-line quality verification requires comparing the actual vehicle_build execution record against the ordered build_spec (options, safety features, regulatory approvals). This link drives build co

attributes.name: configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.configuration. Business justification: Manufacturing traceability requires knowing the exact vehicle configuration (trim, options, color, powertrain) built for each VIN. End-of-line quality gates, warranty registration, and regulatory comp

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Each built vehicle must be tied to its Homologation_Record for VIN‑level compliance verification and reporting.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_line. Business justification: A vehicle build is the physical fulfillment of a specific order line (VIN-level). Delivery confirmation, warranty registration, and VOR (vehicle on road) reporting all require tracing the completed bu

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this vehicle was assembled. Enables plant-level production reporting and capacity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Plant / Work Center

attributes.name: powertrain_variant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.powertrain_variant. Business justification: Recall management, warranty claims, and emissions compliance require tracing which specific powertrain variant (engine/motor/transmission combination) was assembled into each VIN. vehicle_build tracks

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.build_stage. Business justification: Vehicle build references its current build stage; replace string column with FK to build_stage for normalization.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Enables Build ↔ Delivery scheduling; associates each built vehicle with the sales order it fulfills for handover and logistics planning.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: VIN Registration Integration needed for warranty, recall, and regulatory reporting linking build record to VIN registry.

attributes.name: assembly_line_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific production/assembly line within the plant on which this vehicle was built (e.g., LINE-A1, TRIM-LINE-3). Used for line-level throughput analysis, bottleneck identification, and SCADA/PLC integration.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Center / Line Assignment; SAP PP – Work Center

attributes.name: battery_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the high-voltage traction battery pack installed in this vehicle (applicable to HEV, PHEV, BEV). Null for ICE vehicles. Critical for EV battery genealogy, warranty, and end-of-life regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2; EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542; CARB ZEV Regulations

attributes.name: body_shop_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the body shop stage was completed and the body-in-white was released to the paint shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: body_shop_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body-in-white (BIW) entered the body shop for welding and assembly. Key milestone for build genealogy and stage cycle time tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The body style classification of the vehicle being built. Used for production line routing, tooling selection, and regulatory homologation grouping.
attributes.references: SAE J1100 – Vehicle Body Style Classification; UNECE Regulation No. 55

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: The specific BOM (Bill of Materials) version or engineering change level used to build this vehicle. Captured at build time for genealogy and recall traceability. Links to Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability

attributes.name: build_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle build was completed at the final assembly stage and signed off for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if the build is still in progress. Used for cycle time, throughput, and SOP/EOP milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Actual Finish; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: build_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle build process commenced at the first production stage (typically body-in-white or stamping entry). Principal business event timestamp for the build lifecycle. Used for cycle time calculation and OTD (On-Time Delivery) analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Actual Start; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: build_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vehicle build record. Drives shop floor workflow, MES gating, and production reporting. 'on_hold' indicates a quality or material hold; 'rework' indicates a defect requiring corrective action before completion.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle build type: standard (full local assembly), CKD (Completely Knocked Down – assembled from imported kits), SKD (Semi Knocked Down), pilot (pre-SOP trial build), or prototype (engineering validation). Affects BOM, duty classification, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PP – Order Type; WTO Customs Valuation; IATF 16949 APQP

attributes.name: chassis_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the chassis assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: chassis_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the chassis assembly stage for powertrain marriage, suspension, and drivetrain installation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vehicle build record was first created in the MES/data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event, distinct from the build_start_timestamp which is the actual shop floor event time.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: end_of_line_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the automated end-of-line (EOL) functional test performed on the completed vehicle, covering powertrain, brakes, ADAS, and electrical systems. Distinct from quality_gate_status which covers visual/dimensional inspection.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; DOT FMVSS – Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; SAE J1739 FMEA

attributes.name: engine_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the engine unit installed in this vehicle during chassis assembly. Critical for powertrain genealogy, warranty traceability, and recall management.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

attributes.name: final_assembly_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the final assembly stage was completed and the vehicle was released for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: final_assembly_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the final assembly stage for fluids, wheels, glass, and end-of-line checks.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is currently under a production hold (True = on hold). A hold may be triggered by a quality non-conformance, missing parts, engineering change, or safety concern. Drives MES gating to prevent further assembly until resolved.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Management

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the production hold applied to this vehicle build (e.g., QUALITY_DEFECT, MISSING_PART, ECN_CHANGE, SAFETY_CONCERN). Null if hold_flag is False. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QUALITY_DEFECT|MISSING_PART|ECN_CHANGE|SAFETY_CONCERN|SUPPLIER_DEVIATION|TOOLING_FAILURE|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Reason Codes

attributes.name: homologation_market
attributes.description: The target regulatory market for which this vehicle is homologated and built (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR, CHN, AUS). Determines applicable safety, emissions, and labeling standards. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.
attributes.references: UNECE Vehicle Regulations; NHTSA 49 CFR; Euro NCAP; CARB; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicle being built (e.g., 2025). Determines applicable regulatory standards, BOM revision, and homologation requirements. Distinct from the calendar year of production.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J1297 – Model Year Definition

attributes.name: paint_color_code
attributes.description: The manufacturer's paint color code applied to this vehicle during the paint stage (e.g., G1W – Super White, 040 – Classic White). Used for paint shop scheduling, color sequencing optimization, and customer order matching.
attributes.references: SAP PP – Configuration / Variant; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Configuration

attributes.name: paint_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the paint stage was completed and the vehicle body was released to the trim/general assembly line. Null if stage not yet completed.

attributes.name: paint_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body entered the paint shop for priming, painting, and clear-coat application.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; ISO 14001 – Environmental Management (paint VOC emissions)

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly line routing, tooling, and EPA/CARB emissions compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; SAE J1715

attributes.name: quality_gate_status
attributes.description: Result of the end-of-line quality gate inspection for this vehicle build. 'conditional_pass' indicates the vehicle passed with minor deviations requiring dealer rectification. Drives release-to-shipping authorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6 – Release of Products; APQP; Euro NCAP; NHTSA FMVSS

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of rework operations performed on this vehicle build. A count greater than zero indicates quality issues encountered during assembly. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation and FMEA analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC – Statistical Process Control; APQP

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build has been flagged for rework due to a detected defect or non-conformance (True = rework required). Distinct from hold_flag; a vehicle can be in rework while not on hold.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; FMEA Process

attributes.name: scheduled_build_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which this vehicle was scheduled to be built per the production plan (MRP/MES schedule). Used to measure schedule adherence and production plan vs. actual variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scheduled Finish Date; MRP Planning

attributes.name: sop_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is part of the official Start of Production (SOP) launch batch (True = SOP vehicle). SOP vehicles are subject to enhanced quality scrutiny and PPAP sign-off requirements.
attributes.references: APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning; PPAP – Production Part Approval Process; IATF 16949

attributes.name: stamping_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the stamping stage was completed and the body panels were released to the body shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: stamping_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body panels entered the stamping stage. Used for stage-level cycle time analysis and production flow monitoring.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: transmission_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the transmission unit installed in this vehicle. Used for drivetrain genealogy, warranty claims, and component-level recall traceability.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

attributes.name: trim_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the trim assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: trim_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the trim assembly stage for interior fitting, electrical harness installation, and dashboard assembly.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this vehicle build record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trails, and detecting stale records in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal product/model code identifying the vehicle nameplate and variant being built (e.g., F150-XLT-4WD). Maps to the PLM product structure in Siemens Teamcenter. Used for BOM resolution and build sequence planning.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP – Material Master

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: The globally unique 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to this vehicle unit at body-in-white or VIN stamping stage. Conforms to ISO 3779 / NHTSA VIN standard. SSOT for vehicle-level traceability across manufacturing, sales, and after-sales domains.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN Requirements

products.name: production_schedule
products.description: Master production schedule (MPS) record defining planned vehicle production volumes by plant, production line, model, MY (Model Year), and time period (daily, weekly, monthly). Captures scheduled quantity, confirmed quantity, schedule version, freeze horizon, schedule status, and MRP run reference. Integrates with SAP PP MRP and supports capacity planning and supplier call-off generation.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the master production schedule (MPS) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: fleet_contract_id
