attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.fleet_contract. Business justification: Fleet contracts specify committed_volume and delivery_schedule_type that directly drive production schedule creation. Production planners must reference the fleet contract to validate planned_quantity

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the scheduled production will occur. Corresponds to the SAP Plant organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Org Structure; IATF 16949

attributes.name: production_fleet_account_organization_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_fleet_account. Business justification: Fleet customers (rental companies, government fleets) place large committed orders that directly drive production scheduling. OEM fleet program scheduling reports require linking a production schedule

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly, body shop, paint shop, stamping) within the plant where the scheduled build will take place.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: production_organization_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.organization_account. Business justification: Corporate/government fleet programs are managed at the organization account level. Dedicated production runs for B2B fleet contracts (e.g., a government tender for 500 police vehicles) require linking

attributes.name: vehicle_model_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle model (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck, EV) being scheduled for production. Links to the vehicle master product record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of vehicles produced and confirmed as good units by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) during the schedule period. Populated upon schedule completion from Apriso/Dassault MES.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Goods Receipt; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the production planning manager who formally approved this schedule version for release to the shop floor. Required for IATF 16949 document control and audit trail.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP S/4HANA PP Workflow

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the production schedule was formally approved for release. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'released' status and triggers supplier call-off generation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP S/4HANA PP Workflow

attributes.name: assembly_process_stage
attributes.description: Manufacturing process stage covered by this schedule record. Reflects the major shop areas in automotive assembly: stamping (metal forming), body shop (welding/joining), paint (surface treatment), final assembly (powertrain/trim installation), or trim-chassis-final (TCF integrated line).
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Routing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Total available production capacity in hours for this schedule period on the assigned production line, accounting for planned downtime, maintenance windows, and shift patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: Body style classification of the vehicles scheduled for production. Used for production line configuration, tooling setup, and capacity planning by body type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Classification; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: build_sequence_end
attributes.description: Ending sequence number for the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build order within this schedule period. Together with build_sequence_start defines the range of vehicle sequence numbers assigned to this schedule.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Sequencing

attributes.name: build_sequence_start
attributes.description: Starting sequence number for the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build order within this schedule period. Used by MES and AGV systems to sequence vehicle bodies through the production line in the correct order.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Sequencing

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production build type. 'standard' = full series production; 'ckd' = Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit assembly; 'skd' = Semi Knocked Down (SKD) assembly; 'pilot' = pre-production pilot build; 'pre_series' = pre-series validation build.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; APQP Phase 4-5; IATF 16949

attributes.name: calloff_transmission_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when supplier delivery call-offs were transmitted to the supply base for this production schedule. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking and supplier performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4; JIT Standard

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Planned capacity utilization percentage for this schedule period, calculated as (confirmed_quantity × takt_time) / available_capacity_hours × 100. Stored as a planning input from SAP PP capacity leveling, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Leveling; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Number of vehicles confirmed for production after capacity leveling, constraint resolution, and production planning approval. May differ from planned_quantity due to capacity constraints or material availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production schedule record was first created in the system, either by an MRP run or manual entry. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Official End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model/model year. Schedules beyond this date are invalid. Used for phase-out planning, last-time-buy procurement, and regulatory deregistration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; NHTSA Homologation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month number 1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year. Enables alignment of production volumes with financial reporting periods for management accounting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Fiscal Period; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this production schedule belongs. Used for financial planning, CapEx allocation, and EBITDA reporting alignment between production volumes and financial periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Fiscal Year; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: freeze_horizon_date
attributes.description: Date up to which the production schedule is frozen and cannot be changed without formal change control. Protects supplier call-offs and JIT/JIS delivery commitments within the frozen window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planning Time Fence; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4; JIT/JIS Standard

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this schedule record is currently within the freeze horizon and locked against changes. True = frozen (no modifications allowed without change control); False = open for revision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planning Time Fence; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this production schedule record. Updated on every revision, status change, or quantity adjustment. Essential for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicles being scheduled. Used for regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA), BOM versioning, and sales planning. Typically one year ahead of the calendar year for SOP planning.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; EPA CAFE Standards; SAE International MY Definition

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles planned for production in this schedule period as determined by the MRP run. Represents the gross requirement before capacity and constraint adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP Planned Order Quantity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology classification for the vehicles in this schedule. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; EV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Drives regulatory reporting (CAFE, EPA, CARB) and BOM variant selection.
attributes.references: EPA CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; NHTSA FMVSS; SAE J1711

attributes.name: regulatory_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary regulatory market for which these vehicles are being produced. Determines applicable homologation standards (NHTSA/FMVSS for USA, UNECE for Europe, etc.), emissions certification (EPA, CARB, Euro 6), and CAFE compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|DEU|GBR|CHN|JPN|KOR|AUS|BRA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; EPA Emissions Standards; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; CARB; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: schedule_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description for the most recent schedule revision. Examples: material shortage, capacity constraint, demand change, quality hold, tooling failure, model mix adjustment. Required for change control audit trail per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 (Document Control); SAP S/4HANA PP Change Management

attributes.name: schedule_date
attributes.description: The principal planned production date (or start date of the weekly/monthly bucket) for this schedule record. Represents the real-world business event date when production is planned to occur.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planned Order; IATF 16949

attributes.name: schedule_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the production schedule period. For daily schedules this equals schedule_date; for weekly/monthly buckets this marks the last day of the planning period.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for production planners to record contextual notes, exceptions, or special instructions associated with this schedule record. Examples: tooling changeover notes, quality hold references, special customer order constraints.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the production schedule record, sourced from SAP PP (Production Planning). Used for cross-system reference and communication with supply chain and manufacturing teams.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production schedule record. 'draft' = initial planning; 'released' = approved for execution; 'frozen' = within freeze horizon, no changes allowed; 'in_execution' = active shop floor production; 'completed' = all planned units built; 'cancelled' = schedule voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Time granularity of the production schedule record. 'daily' = day-level MPS; 'weekly' = weekly bucket plan; 'monthly' = monthly capacity plan. Determines the planning horizon and supplier call-off frequency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the production schedule. Each MRP (Material Requirements Planning) run or manual revision increments this counter, enabling version comparison and rollback analysis.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production is scheduled to complete for this schedule record. Used for shift planning, takt time validation, and downstream logistics coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Order Scheduling; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production is scheduled to begin on the line for this schedule record. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing, AGV routing, and supplier call-off timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Order Scheduling; Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Shift configuration planned for this production schedule period. Determines available production hours and workforce requirements. Single = 1 shift/day; Double = 2 shifts/day; Triple = 3 shifts/day; Weekend = weekend-only production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Official Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model/model year being scheduled. Marks the formal launch of series production. Used to validate that schedule dates fall within the active production window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Program Management; APQP Phase 5

attributes.name: supplier_calloff_generated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether supplier delivery call-offs (JIT/JIS delivery schedules) have been generated and transmitted to suppliers based on this production schedule. True = call-offs sent; False = pending call-off generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; JIT/JIS Standard; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds per vehicle unit for this production schedule. Takt time = available production time divided by customer demand rate. Drives line balancing, AGV pacing, and JIS sequencing intervals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Rate Routing; Apriso/Dassault MES; SAE Manufacturing Standards

products.name: production_bom
products.description: Manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM) record representing the production-level BOM used on the shop floor for a specific vehicle configuration and model year. Distinct from the engineering BOM (eBOM) in the engineering domain — this is the manufacturing BOM (mBOM) as released to production. Captures BOM header (vehicle model, MY, plant, effectivity dates), BOM status, and reference to the engineering change order that authorized it. Managed via SAP PP and Teamcenter PLM BOM transfer.
products.reference: SAP PP Manufacturing BOM (mBOM) / Teamcenter BOM Transfer

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the manufacturing Bill of Materials (mBOM) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP PP BOM Header (CS01/CS02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.configuration. Business justification: Configuration-specific BOMs are standard in automotive (EV vs ICE variant of same model have different BOMs). Linking production_bom to configuration enables PPAP documentation, configuration-level co

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: BOM Management Report requires each BOM to be tied to a vehicle model to ensure correct component list per model.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: production_bom has a plant_code STRING field — a denormalized reference to the plant where this BOM is used. Replacing it with a proper FK to plant normalizes the relationship. plant_code is removed a

attributes.name: platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.platform. Business justification: Production BOMs in automotive are structured at platform level (e.g., MQB, TNGA). Platform-level BOM management drives component commonality reporting, platform cost analysis, and engineering change c

attributes.name: powertrain_variant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.powertrain_variant. Business justification: Powertrain-variant-specific BOMs are a core automotive engineering practice — EV, PHEV, and ICE variants of the same model have distinct BOMs. Linking enables powertrain cost analysis, supplier sourci

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_supplier. Business justification: Automotive BOMs are single- or dual-sourced; linking BOM to nominated supplier enables PPAP validation, supplier calloff scheduling, and IATF 16949 traceability audits. Manufacturing engineers expect

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: production_bom has a production_line_code STRING field — a denormalized reference to the production line this BOM is used on. Replacing it with a proper FK normalizes the relationship. production_line

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.routing. Business justification: production_bom has a routing_number STRING field — a denormalized reference to the routing associated with this BOM. In automotive manufacturing, a production BOM is paired with a routing (the BOM def

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this manufacturing BOM (mBOM) to the originating engineering BOM (eBOM) in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from shop floor execution back to the engineering design intent. The eBOM-to-mBOM transformation is managed via the PLM-SAP integration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; PTC Windchill EDM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

tag_set.value: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM received formal approval from the designated authority. Precedes the release_date in the BOM lifecycle workflow. Required for IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the approving authority (e.g., Chief Engineer, Manufacturing Manager) who approved this BOM for production release. Distinct from released_by — approval may be a separate workflow step in Teamcenter PLM or SAP workflow.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.3 – Design and Development Outputs; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: Current APQP phase associated with this BOM's program lifecycle. Phase 1=Plan and Define, Phase 2=Product Design and Development, Phase 3=Process Design and Development, Phase 4=Product and Process Validation, Phase 5=Launch/Feedback. Tracks BOM maturity relative to the program development gate.
attributes.references: AIAG APQP 2nd Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Program Management

attributes.name: assembly_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is assembled as a Completely Built Unit (CBU), Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit for overseas assembly, or Semi Knocked Down (SKD) kit. Determines the BOM structure, component packaging, and applicable customs/import regulations for the target market.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Type; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; Customs Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The base quantity of the header material for which the BOM component quantities are defined (e.g., 1 vehicle). All component quantities in the BOM are expressed relative to this base quantity. Corresponds to the SAP BOM header base quantity field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Base Quantity; ISO 9001 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the BOM base quantity (e.g., 'EA' for each/vehicle, 'PC' for piece, 'SET' for set). Corresponds to the SAP material master base unit of measure. Ensures consistent quantity calculations during MRP explosion and production order processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|L|M|M2|M3|SET — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: bom_alternative
attributes.description: SAP BOM alternative identifier (e.g., '01', '02') distinguishing multiple valid BOM configurations for the same material and plant. Supports variant BOMs for different production lines or regional configurations (e.g., LHD vs RHD, CKD vs SKD).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Alternative; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the manufacturing BOM, typically including the vehicle model, model year, plant, and key configuration attributes (e.g., '2025 F-150 XLT 3.5L EcoBoost AWD – Detroit Assembly Plant – MY2025 Production BOM'). Used for display in SAP, Teamcenter PLM, and reporting tools.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Description; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: The maximum depth/level of the BOM hierarchy for this manufacturing BOM (e.g., 1 = single-level, 5 = five levels deep). Used to understand BOM complexity and to control multi-level BOM explosion in MRP and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Multi-Level BOM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the manufacturing BOM. 'draft' indicates the BOM is under engineering review. 'released' means it has been authorized for production use. 'frozen' indicates no further changes are permitted (e.g., during active production run). 'superseded' means a newer BOM version has replaced it. 'obsolete' means the BOM is no longer valid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use in the manufacturing process. 'production' is the standard mBOM used on the shop floor. 'phantom' represents sub-assemblies that are not stocked. 'sales' is used for variant configuration. 'spare_parts' is for after-sales service. 'co_product' is for by-products in manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Category; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_usage
attributes.description: SAP BOM usage indicator defining the organizational context in which the BOM is applied. 'production' (SAP usage 1) is the standard for shop floor manufacturing. 'engineering' (SAP usage 2) is for design/development. 'universal' (SAP usage 3) applies across all usages. Determines which BOM is selected during MRP and production order processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Usage (T415); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the manufacturing BOM (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Incremented each time the BOM is revised through an approved Engineering Change Order. Enables version history tracking and rollback capability for quality investigations.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Versioning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Change History

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for creating or modifying this BOM version (e.g., 'Cost reduction – substitute supplier for part X', 'Regulatory compliance – CARB Tier 3 emission update', 'Quality improvement – NVH fix per TSB-2024-001'). Required for IATF 16949 change control documentation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6 – Control of Changes; SAP PP Change Master; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.6

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct component line items (BOM positions) in this manufacturing BOM. Provides a quick indicator of BOM complexity and is used for completeness validation during BOM release. Does not include phantom sub-assembly components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Item Count; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturing BOM record was first created in the source system (SAP PP or Teamcenter PLM). Represents the business event of BOM creation, not the ETL load time. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: The Engineering Change Order (ECO) number that authorized the creation or last modification of this manufacturing BOM. Provides full traceability from the shop floor BOM back to the formal engineering change management process in Teamcenter PLM. Required for IATF 16949 change control compliance.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Engineering Change Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; SAP PP ECO Integration

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this manufacturing BOM version is no longer valid for production use. Corresponds to the SAP BOM 'Valid To' date. Null indicates the BOM is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used to manage BOM transitions during model year changeovers and End of Production (EOP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this manufacturing BOM version becomes effective and valid for production use. Corresponds to the SAP BOM 'Valid From' date. Used for date-effective BOM explosion in MRP and production order creation. Aligns with Start of Production (SOP) planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAE J1739

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production of this vehicle configuration ceases. Used for last-time-buy planning, spare parts provisioning, and regulatory compliance archiving.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAP PP Production Planning; APQP

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory homologation (type approval) for the vehicle configuration defined by this BOM in the target regulatory market. 'approved' is required before vehicles built to this BOM can be legally sold in the target market. Managed through the Regulatory Compliance and Homologation process.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 567 – Certification; UNECE WP.29 Type Approval; Euro NCAP; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM uses SAP Variant Configuration (VC) to support multiple vehicle variants from a single configurable BOM structure. True = configurable BOM with characteristic-based component selection. False = fixed BOM for a single specific vehicle configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration (LO-VC); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: is_phantom_assembly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the header material of this BOM is a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that is not physically stocked or produced as a discrete unit. Phantom assemblies are 'exploded through' during MRP and production order processing. Common for sub-assemblies in JIS manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Phantom Assembly (Special Procurement Key 50); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this manufacturing BOM record in the source system. Used to detect changes during incremental data loads into the Databricks Silver Layer and to support BOM change history auditing required by IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP BOM Change History; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number of the header material (finished vehicle or major assembly) for which this BOM is defined. This is the top-level material in the BOM hierarchy, corresponding to the vehicle configuration or assembly unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master (MM60); SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The four-digit automotive Model Year (MY) for which this manufacturing BOM is valid (e.g., 2025). Determines the applicable regulatory standards, feature content, and homologation requirements. Aligns with NHTSA and EPA model year definitions.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN; SAP PP Material Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology for which this BOM is defined. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Determines applicable emissions regulations (EPA, CARB, WLTP) and BOM component sets.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; CAFE Standards; SAE J1711

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Status of the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) for the components in this BOM. PPAP is the AIAG/IATF 16949 process that verifies supplier components meet design and specification requirements before production launch. 'approved' is required before the BOM can be released to production.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1; SAP QM – Quality Notifications

attributes.name: predecessor_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the previous manufacturing BOM version that this BOM supersedes. Enables backward navigation in the BOM version chain for change impact analysis and quality investigations. Null for the initial BOM version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the target regulatory market for which this BOM is homologated (e.g., 'US-FEDERAL', 'US-CARB', 'EU-EURO6', 'JP-JC08', 'CN-CHINA6'). Determines applicable emissions standards (EPA, CARB, Euro 6, WLTP), safety regulations (NHTSA FMVSS, UNECE), and CAFE compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR – FMVSS; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13; Euro NCAP; UNECE WP.29; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM was formally released to production (status changed to 'released'). Marks the point at which the BOM is authorized for use in production orders and MRP planning. Corresponds to the SAP BOM release date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Release; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; APQP Phase 4

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the manufacturing engineer or release authority who formally released this BOM to production in SAP PP or Teamcenter PLM. Required for audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP Authorization; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision level of the BOM (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' or '01', '02'). Used in conjunction with bom_version to track incremental changes within a version. Aligns with SAP BOM revision level and Teamcenter PLM revision management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Revision; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production begins using this BOM configuration. Critical for program management, supplier readiness, and PPAP completion tracking.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: superseded_by_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the newer manufacturing BOM that has replaced this one (populated when bom_status = 'superseded'). Enables forward navigation in the BOM version chain for traceability and historical analysis. Null when this is the current active BOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model (nameplate) for which this mBOM is defined (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Used to associate the BOM with the correct vehicle program in PLM and SAP.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP Material Master

products.name: material_consumption
products.description: Transactional record capturing actual material consumption (goods issue) against a production order on the shop floor. Tracks consumed part number, quantity consumed, unit of measure, consumption timestamp, work center, production order reference, storage location, batch number, and variance from planned BOM quantity. Feeds SAP MM goods movement and cost accounting for production variance reporting.

attributes.name: material_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each material consumption (goods issue) transaction record on the shop floor. Primary key of this table.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Goods Movement

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the shop floor operator or MES user who confirmed or posted the material consumption. Used for accountability, audit trail, and operator-level quality traceability per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – User (USNAM); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2; SuccessFactors

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Material consumption reports must reference the specific inbound part receipt to calculate usage rates and supplier performance metrics.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the material consumption occurred. Aligns with SAP organizational unit for plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Plant Organizational Unit

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_goods_receipt. Business justification: IATF 16949 requires full part traceability from goods receipt through production consumption. This link enables 3-way match reconciliation, quantity variance analysis between received and consumed sto

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_bom. Business justification: Material consumption records actual goods issues against a production BOM. The FK to production_bom normalizes the BOM reference. bom_version is a denormalized copy of production_bom.bom_version and c

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order against which this material was consumed. Links consumption to the manufacturing work order in SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – Production Order

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the consumed part or component. Corresponds to the SAP Material Master (MM) object.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (bin, supermarket, line-side buffer) from which the material was issued for consumption.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: VIN-level material traceability is a regulatory and quality requirement in automotive — recall investigations and warranty root-cause analysis require knowing exactly which parts (by batch/serial) wer

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (assembly station, stamping cell, paint booth, etc.) on the shop floor where the material was consumed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: assembly_station_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific assembly station or line position (JIS – Just-in-Sequence station) where the material was consumed. More granular than work center; used for shop floor traceability.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Supplier or internal batch/lot number of the consumed material. Critical for traceability, recall management, and IATF 16949 batch traceability requirements. Nullable for non-batch-managed materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Batch Management (CHARG); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: bom_item_number
attributes.description: The BOM line item number identifying the specific component position within the production BOM. Links the consumption record back to the engineering BOM structure in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Item (STPO-POSNR); Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material consumption record. 'posted' = goods issue confirmed in SAP; 'reversed' = goods issue reversed (movement type 262); 'blocked' = held for quality review; 'pending' = awaiting MES confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Movement Status; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the material was physically issued from stock and consumed at the work center on the shop floor. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Posting Date/Time; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the consumption variance (actual cost minus planned cost) in plant currency. Positive = cost overrun; negative = cost saving. Key metric for production cost variance reporting in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Production Variance (KKBC_ORD); IATF 16949

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this material consumption record was first created in the source system (SAP MM or MES). Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Creation Timestamp; IATF 16949 Record Retention

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the material cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency manufacturing operations across global plants.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: goods_movement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible SAP material document number generated when the goods issue (movement type 261) is posted. Serves as the business-facing transaction identifier traceable in SAP MM.

attributes.name: goods_movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code indicating the nature of the goods movement (e.g., 261 = goods issue to production order, 262 = reversal, 291 = goods issue to cost center). Drives inventory and cost accounting postings.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this material consumption record in the source system. Used for incremental data load detection and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Change Timestamp; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: Standard cost value of the consumed material quantity at the time of goods issue, expressed in the plant currency. Calculated as quantity consumed × standard price from SAP Material Master. Feeds production cost accounting and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Standard Cost; FI Goods Issue Valuation

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the Apriso/Dassault MES system that triggered or confirmed this material consumption event. Enables cross-system reconciliation between MES shop floor execution and SAP MM goods movements.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Transaction ID; SAP S/4HANA MM Integration

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year (MY) of the vehicle being assembled (e.g., '2025'). Used for model-year-level consumption analysis, BOM alignment, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Model Year; NHTSA MY Definition

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The routing operation number within the production order at which the material was consumed (e.g., operation 0010 = body shop, 0020 = paint, 0030 = final assembly). Enables process-step-level consumption analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Operation (VORNR); Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: original_goods_movement_number
attributes.description: Reference to the original SAP material document number that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail for reversed consumption transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal Reference Document

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of this material as specified in the Bill of Materials (BOM) for the production order. Used to calculate consumption variance against actual quantity consumed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Component Quantity; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date for the goods issue in SAP, which may differ from the physical consumption timestamp. Used for period-end cost accounting and production variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Posting Date; IATF 16949

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain type of the vehicle being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives BOM variant selection and consumption expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Configuration; CAFE/EPA Powertrain Classification

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production line (e.g., 'LINE-A', 'TRIM-2', 'PAINT-EAST') where the material was consumed. Used for line-level consumption analysis and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Production Line; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot
attributes.description: SAP QM inspection lot number associated with the consumed material batch, if the material is subject to incoming or in-process quality inspection. Links consumption to quality results for IATF 16949 traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Inspection Lot (QMEL); IATF 16949 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the material consumed (goods issued) against the production order. Expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. Core quantitative fact for this transaction.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between actual quantity consumed and planned BOM quantity (actual minus planned). Positive value indicates over-consumption; negative indicates under-consumption. Key input for production variance reporting and cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Production Variance; IATF 16949 SPC

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this consumption record is a reversal (cancellation) of a previously posted goods issue. True = this is a reversal document; False = original consumption posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal Document (STORNO); Goods Movement

attributes.name: scrap_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the consumed material was scrapped (True) rather than incorporated into the vehicle assembly. Scrap consumption is tracked separately for waste reporting, IATF 16949 scrap analysis, and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scrap; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for material scrap when scrap_indicator is True (e.g., 'DAMAGE', 'DEFECT', 'WRONG_PART', 'PROCESS_LOSS'). Used for scrap root cause analysis and PPM defect rate reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAMAGE|DEFECT|WRONG_PART|PROCESS_LOSS|HANDLING_ERROR|SUPPLIER_DEFECT|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scrap Reason; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; FMEA

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Individual serial number of the consumed component where serial number management is active (e.g., ECU, battery module, transmission). Enables unit-level traceability for safety-critical parts. Nullable for non-serialized materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Serial Number Management; NHTSA Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift during which the material was consumed (DAY, AFTERNOON, NIGHT). Used for shift-level consumption analysis, variance trending, and workforce productivity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this consumption record originated (SAP_MM = SAP S/4HANA MM goods movement, MES_APRISO = Apriso/Dassault MES, SAP_PP = SAP Production Planning, MANUAL = manual entry). Supports data lineage in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer – Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: supplier_number
attributes.description: SAP vendor/supplier number of the supplier who provided the consumed material. Used for supplier-level consumption analysis, PPAP traceability, and supply chain variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Vendor Master (LFA1); IATF 16949 Supplier Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the consumed quantity (e.g., EA = each, KG = kilogram, L = litre, M = metre, PC = piece). Aligns with SAP base UoM from Material Master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|PC|SET|ROL|BOX — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Quantity variance expressed as a percentage of the planned BOM quantity ((actual - planned) / planned × 100). Used for threshold-based alerting and PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Variance Analysis; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model or platform being assembled (e.g., 'F150', 'CAMRY-HEV', 'SILVERADO-EV'). Used for model-level consumption aggregation and BOM variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material (Finished Vehicle); Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: wip_order_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential position of this consumption event within the production order's WIP (Work in Progress) processing sequence. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) ordering analysis and shop floor flow traceability.

products.name: capacity_plan
products.description: Master record for plant and line capacity planning, capturing planned production capacity by plant, production line, shift pattern, and planning period (weekly/monthly). Includes rated capacity (JPH × available hours), demonstrated capacity, capacity utilization percentage, bottleneck work center, planned overtime hours, and capacity plan version. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) and capital investment decisions.

attributes.name: capacity_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity plan record in the manufacturing domain. Primary key for the capacity_plan data product.

attributes.name: bottleneck_work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center identified as the capacity bottleneck constraining overall line throughput during this planning period. Used to prioritize capacity improvement investments and focus S&OP constraint management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Work Center (CM21); Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: fleet_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.fleet_contract. Business justification: Large fleet contracts (government/national accounts) with high committed_volume directly trigger capacity planning decisions — headcount, shifts, capex investments. Capacity planners must reference th

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Capacity planning in automotive is performed per vehicle model per plant/line. Model-level capacity reports, S&OP processes, and launch readiness reviews all require linking capacity plans to the vehi

attributes.name: organization_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_fleet_account. Business justification: Fleet renewal contracts (e.g., 2,000-unit rental fleet order) are primary demand signals that trigger capacity plan adjustments. Automotive capacity planners must link capacity plans to fleet accounts

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant for which this capacity plan is defined. Links to the manufacturing.plant master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center / Plant; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly line, body shop line, paint line) within the plant for which capacity is being planned. Links to the manufacturing.work_center or production line master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Line; Apriso/Dassault MES — Line Configuration

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_schedule. Business justification: Capacity plans are developed in response to production schedules — the planned production volumes in the schedule drive the capacity requirements analysis. This FK links the capacity plan to the sched

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the capacity plan was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status in the S&OP governance process.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the S&OP or manufacturing leadership authority who approved this capacity plan. Required for audit trail and governance compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3 — Organizational Roles; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: available_hours
attributes.description: Total scheduled production hours available in the planning period after accounting for planned downtime, shift breaks, and scheduled maintenance. Used in conjunction with rated_capacity_jph to compute rated capacity in units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Available Capacity; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: bottleneck_constraint_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary capacity constraint at the bottleneck work center (e.g., 'Paint oven cycle time limits throughput to 58 JPH', 'Robotic welding cell maintenance window reduces available hours'). Supports root cause analysis and CapEx justification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Notes; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_gap_units
attributes.description: Difference between planned_production_units and demonstrated_capacity_units, representing the capacity shortfall or surplus for the planning period. Positive value indicates a capacity gap requiring corrective action (overtime, additional shifts, CapEx); negative value indicates surplus capacity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Leveling; S&OP Process; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capacity planning methodology used. 'rough_cut' (RCCP — Rough Cut Capacity Planning) for high-level S&OP; 'detailed' for work-center-level CRP (Capacity Requirements Planning); 'constraint_based' for Theory of Constraints analysis; 'what_if' for scenario planning and CapEx evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — RCCP/CRP; APICS CPIM Body of Knowledge

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Planned capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (planned_production_units / rated_capacity_units) × 100. Drives S&OP decisions on overtime, additional shifts, and capital investment. Target thresholds are typically 85–95% for automotive assembly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Utilization; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; S&OP Best Practice

attributes.name: capex_amount
attributes.description: Estimated capital expenditure amount required to address the capacity gap identified in this plan. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for CapEx budget submissions and investment approval processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Investment Management; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capex_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity plan identifies a requirement for capital investment (CapEx) to close a capacity gap (e.g., new tooling, additional robots, facility expansion). Triggers CapEx approval workflow in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — CapEx Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: changeover_hours
attributes.description: Hours allocated for model changeovers, tooling changes, and line reconfigurations during the planning period. Relevant for mixed-model assembly lines producing multiple vehicle variants (e.g., ICE and BEV on the same line).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Setup Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this capacity plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-plant, multi-currency manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: daily_production_target
attributes.description: Planned number of vehicles to be produced per working day during the planning period, derived from planned_production_units / working_days. Used for daily MES scheduling and shift-level production targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Daily Production Target; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: demonstrated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Actual production output achieved in a comparable prior period, used as the realistic baseline for capacity planning. Reflects real-world constraints such as quality losses, minor stoppages, and changeovers. Key input to APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) capacity studies.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1 — PPAP Capacity Study; APQP Reference Manual

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Planned End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when production of the model is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity wind-down planning and asset redeployment decisions.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this capacity plan belongs, used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) alignment, budget planning, and financial reporting. Format: FY followed by 4-digit year (e.g., FY2025).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Fiscal Year; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: headcount_required
attributes.description: Total direct labor headcount required to execute the planned production volume during the planning period. Used for workforce planning, hiring decisions, and labor cost budgeting in SuccessFactors and SAP CO.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors — Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO — Labor Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2

attributes.name: is_bottleneck_constrained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capacity plan is constrained by a bottleneck work center that limits overall line throughput below the planned production target. When True, the bottleneck_work_center_id and bottleneck_constraint_description fields are populated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Scheduling; Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Automotive model year (MY) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Capacity plans are typically aligned to MY production programs, SOP (Start of Production), and EOP (End of Production) milestones.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; NHTSA MY Designation

attributes.name: number_of_shifts
attributes.description: Number of production shifts planned per working day for this capacity plan (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts). Directly determines available production hours and total capacity for the planning period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Model; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Together with plan_start_date, defines the planning window for capacity supply and demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the capacity plan record, used in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) communications, SAP PP capacity planning transactions (CM01/CM21), and cross-functional reporting. Format: CP-{PLANT}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQ}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Used to align capacity supply with demand signals from S&OP and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity plan record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress; 'submitted' indicates pending approval; 'approved' indicates sign-off by S&OP leadership; 'active' indicates the operative plan driving production scheduling; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'archived' indicates historical record.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the capacity plan, enabling management of multiple planning iterations (e.g., v1.0, v2.0) within the same planning period. Supports S&OP cycle versioning and plan-over-plan variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total planned downtime hours for the production line during the planning period, including scheduled maintenance, tooling changeovers, model changeovers, and planned shutdowns. Reduces available production hours from the theoretical maximum.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Maintenance Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Subset of planned downtime hours specifically allocated to preventive and predictive maintenance activities on production equipment. Tracked separately from changeover downtime for maintenance KPI reporting and SAP PM integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Preventive Maintenance; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours planned for the production line during the planning period to meet production targets beyond standard shift capacity. Feeds into workforce cost planning and labor budget in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: planned_production_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicles planned for production in the planning period as agreed in the S&OP process. Represents the demand signal that capacity must satisfy. Compared against rated and demonstrated capacity to identify gaps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; S&OP Process

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the capacity planning horizon for this record. 'weekly' supports short-term MES scheduling; 'monthly' supports S&OP cycles; 'quarterly' and 'annual' support CapEx and strategic workforce planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: planning_scenario
attributes.description: Demand scenario underpinning this capacity plan. 'base' reflects the consensus S&OP forecast; 'optimistic' reflects upside demand; 'pessimistic' reflects downside risk; 'stretch' reflects maximum achievable output. Enables scenario comparison for executive decision-making.
attributes.references: S&OP Best Practice; SAP S/4HANA PP — Planning Scenario

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology type planned for production in this capacity plan. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Impacts tooling, line configuration, and capacity requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE Regulations

attributes.name: rated_capacity_jph
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum production rate expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) for the production line under ideal conditions. Derived from takt time and line design specifications. Used as the baseline for capacity utilization calculations in S&OP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAE J3061

attributes.name: rated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum number of vehicles that can be produced in the planning period, calculated as rated_capacity_jph × available_hours. Represents the upper bound of production capacity for S&OP and CapEx planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: sap_capacity_plan_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this capacity plan record in SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning) module, used for data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01/CM21); Data Lineage Best Practice

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Planned Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when full-rate production is scheduled to begin. Critical for capacity ramp-up planning and APQP milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds for the production line during this planning period, representing the rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand. Takt time = available production time / planned production units. Core metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) and line balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center Takt Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was last modified. Tracks plan revisions through the S&OP cycle and supports change management auditing.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: working_days
attributes.description: Number of scheduled working days in the planning period after excluding weekends, public holidays, and planned plant shutdowns. Used to compute daily production targets and available hours.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Factory Calendar; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Governs the inbound supply chain from tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers through to plant receiving. Owns supplier master data, RFQ (Request for Quotation) events, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) records, JIT/JIS delivery schedules, inbound logistics, supplier performance metrics (PPM - Parts Per Million defect rates, OTD - On-Time Delivery), and CKD/SKD kit management for global assembly operations. Integrates with SAP MM and PTC Windchill.

products.name: supply_supplier
products.description: Master record for all tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers in the automotive supply chain. Captures supplier identity, classification (direct/indirect, tier level), IATF 16949 certification status, DUNS number, geographic footprint, commodity codes, preferred currency, payment terms, and supplier lifecycle status (active, probation, disqualified). SSOT for supplier identity within the supply domain; integrates with SAP MM vendor master and PTC Windchill supplier collaboration.

attributes.name: supply_supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supply_supplier data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to procurement.procurement_supplier (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; procurement designated SSOT owner for supplier).

products.name: inbound_part
products.description: Master record for every purchased part number sourced from external suppliers. Captures OEM part number, supplier part number cross-reference, commodity group, material type (raw, sub-assembly, CKD kit), unit of measure, PPAP approval status, engineering change level, hazardous material flag, country of origin, and customs tariff code. Bridges SAP MM material master and PTC Windchill parts classification for supply-domain-owned purchased parts.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Master (MARA/MARC) — Purchased Parts

attributes.name: inbound_part_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Material receipt cost is allocated to a Cost Center for inventory valuation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: sku_master_id

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id

Procurement teams need part-to-contract traceability for price valida

attributes.name: average_cost

attributes.name: commodity_group

attributes.name: country_of_origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: engineering_change_level

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag

attributes.name: height_mm

Captures nomination date, program/platform code, nominated supplier, awarded annual volume, target piece price, SOR (Statement of Requirements) reference, nomination status (nominated, confirmed, withdrawn), and the responsible commodity buyer. Precedes the RFQ and PPAP process. SSOT for sourcing award decisions; distinct from procurement domain's strategic sourcing strategy — this is the operational award record.

products.description: This association product represents the inspection requirement between an inspection plan and a characteristic. It captures the specific measurement instructions, tolerances, sampling rules, and acceptance criteria that apply when a particular characteristic is inspected under a particular inspection plan. Each record links one inspection_plan to one characteristic with attributes that exist only in the context of this inspection requirement.. Existence Justification: In automotive quality management (IATF 16949 / VDA standards), an inspection plan is explicitly structured as a collection of multiple characteristics to be inspected, and each characteristic can appear in multiple inspection plans (e.g., 'bore diameter' is inspected in incoming material plans, in-process plans, and final vehicle PDI plans). The business actively manages 'inspection characteristics' or 'inspection plan lines' as operational entities with plan-specific measurement instructions, tolerances, sampling rules, and acceptance criteria that vary by context.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Inventory management for raw materials, components, WIP (Work in Progress), finished goods, and service parts across plants, warehouses, and dealer networks. Manages stock levels, inventory movements, cycle counting, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution, and SKU master data. Tracks inventory accuracy, turnover rates, obsolescence, and safety stock levels. Includes warehouse management (SAP WM), lot traceability, and serialized inventory for high-value components (ECU, batteries).

Captures SKU identity, classification, unit of measure, weight/dimensions, hazardous material flags, shelf-life, and MRP planning parameters. Referenced by all inventory movement and stock transactions.
